# GameSurge — July 2002 promotional feature description

- Original source: [July 2002 news archive — Robin Hood item](https://gamesurge.com/archive/july2002.shtml)
- Author / publication: Falcon, posting credit; GameSurge.
- Language / date: English; July 2002 archive; exact item day not verified.
- Access: Substantial indexed Robin Hood passage inspected; direct retrieval failed.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The promotional item describes more than forty missions divided into robbery/infiltration, castle attacks, and ambushes. It advertises selecting five characters, distinct abilities, and varied day, night, and fog presentations across towns and forest intersections. A winter 2002 retail window is given.

The text also markets environmental interactions such as climbing, entering buildings, operating traps, and lowering drawbridges. These are prerelease promotional claims rather than measured final-game coverage. Its sweeping claims of historical research and realism should be attributed to the publicity, not adopted as independent conclusions.
